strings: Details related to Licenses, Permits, Certificates or Others.
Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.
Code specifying the category of a document.
Date and time of effectiveness of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).
Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).
Code specifying the function of a document.
Identification of a specific information exchange.
Document reference number, assigned by the Trader
Document reference number, assigned by the Government
Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.
Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.
Name of the location at which a document was issued and when needed, signed or otherwise authenticated.
Code specifying the language used or requested.

UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

Quantity specifying the total number of goods items within a document.
Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.
Code specifying whether the document (e.g. permit, bond, license) is for single use or multiple use.
Details related to the authentication of a document.
Code specifying the type of authentication.
Date and time when this authentication was actually signed or otherwise authenticated.
Identification of the location where a document was signed or otherwise authenticated.

Name of a location where a document was signed or otherwise authenticated.
Details related to an authenticating party.
Name of the party which certifies that a document is authentic.
Identification of a party which certifies that a document is authentic.
International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list
Code specifying the role of a party.
Code specifying the type of address.
Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.
Name of the country or other geographical entity.
Code specifying the name of a country subdivision.
Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.
Not to be used in combination with Street name, House number, House number addition and P.O. Box
Identification of the postal zone or address.
Details related to an additional identification of a party.
Number indicating the position in a sequence.
Identification of an additional party (e.g. VAT number).

International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list.
To be used with CDT attributes "Identification Scheme. Identifier" and
"Identification Scheme Agency. Identifier" to make the information unique
Details related to a person designated under relevant legislation for the purpose of issuing official assurances.
Name of a person designated under relevant legislation for the purpose of issuing official assurances.
Identification of a person designated under relevant legislation for the purpose of issuing official assurances.
Details related to the government office at which a declaration is lodged.
Identification of a location at which a declaration is lodged.
Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.
Identification of a document providing additional information.
Date and time of issuing an additional document and when needed, signed or otherwise authenticated.
Code specifying the type of an additional document.
Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

In case of using Additional statement code, text or indicator you can make the information more specific by also using Additional statement type.
If there are more than 1 occurrences you should always use it in combination with the type.
Code specifying the form of an additional statement.
Code specifying the subject of the additional statement.
Code specifying the issuing country of the identification.
Details related to communication including number and number type.
Code specifying the type of communication address.
Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.
Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment whether or not they are subject to the same customs procedure, tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.
Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

Quantity specifying the total number shown on bill of lading or on split shipment. It will be the actual number of pieces boarded on the conveyance. (Not necessarily the smallest external packaging unit for the shipment).
Details related to the location of acceptance.
Name of the location where the goods are taken over by the carrier from the consignor.
Identification of the location where the goods are taken over by the carrier from the consignor.
Date and time when the goods are taken over.
Date and time by when the event has to be completed.
Details related to the means of transport at arrival.
Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at the time of arrival.
Identification of the means of transport at the time of arrival.

Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number
Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.
Crossing the border transport means name
Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Transport means crossing the border identifier
Identification of the means of transport used in crossing the border.
Type of means of transport crossing the border code
Code specifying type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Mode of transport crossing the border code
Code specifying mode of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Date and time of departure of the means of transport.
Identification of the journey of a means of transport, for example voyage number, flight number, trip number.
Details related to the first arrival location.
Identification of the arrival location. This would be a port for sea, airport for air and border post for land crossing.
UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list
Code specifying the subject of the characteristic.
Code specifying the form of a characteristic value.
UN/EDIFACT code list 7111 / User code list
Details related to the defects noted.
Description of the rectification of defects.
Details related to the responsible government agency.

Identification of a party which manufactures goods.

Identification of the registered owner of means the of transport.

Identification of a party providing the transport of goods between named points.

Name of the party to which goods are consigned.
Identification of a party to which goods are consigned.

Code specifying the status of goods as identified by customs for regulation purposes or as a result of an action by the declarant or government agency.
UN/EDIFACT code list 4405 OR User code list
Identification of the consignment item (e.g. for CITES codes A, B, C, D).
Details related to the computer file or program stored in a binary format.
Name of the author for this binary file.
Identification of the version for this binary file.
Name of the file usually including the file type for this binary file.
Identification of the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for this binary file.
Code specifying the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type for this binary file.
Code specifying the encoding of this binary file.
Code specifying the character set for this binary file.
Binary object included for this file.
Information on access for this binary file such as security and download parameters.
Measure of the size of this binary file.
Code specifying the type of binary file, such as photo, spreadsheet.
Hash code of the binary file.
Code specifying the algorithm used to calculate the hash code (e.g. MD5).
Details related to the properties of the goods.
Description of the cargo in general terms only.
Description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for cross-border regulatory purposes such as customs, phytosanitary, statistical or transport.
Identification of the production lot by number.
Amount indicating the value of the commodity (not to be used for customs valuation purposes).
Quantity specifying the number of regulated items.
Statement regarding the intended use of the commodity.

Code specifying the grouping of similar products into non-commercial categories that are assigned by and useful to regulatory authorities.  More specific than the Goods group name (WCO ID 331) and Goods group name, coded (WCO ID 332).
Code specifying the grouping of similar products identifying categories that are assigned by and useful to the cross-border regulatory authorities.
UN/EDIFACT code list 3055 / User code list (1131)
Code specifying the intended use of the commodity.
Date and time that the commodity was manufactured, produced, or grown.
Date and time the commodity was acquired.
Details related to a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.
Name of the location of a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.
Identification of a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.
Details related to the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Identification of the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Code specifying the scientific name of original plant/animal used as a material for food products, medications, cosmetics, medical materials, etc.
Code specifying the commodity classification (e.g. Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), Export Control Classification Code (ECCC), UNDG Code list, International Code of Zoological Nomenclature).
Details related to the line item of an invoice.
Amount due for each chargeable item of goods or services.
Details related to a Process which has, will, or is required to be performed on a commodity.
Date and time at which a specified event becomes effective.
Code specifying the process or production associated with the commodity (e.g. method of growing, pretreatment, etc.).
Description of the production method or other process applied to the commodity.
Date and time on which the process associated with the commodity was performed.
Details related to the producer of the product.
Name of the party or person who has produced the product.
Identification of the party or person who has produced the product.
Details related to the tangible article or substance produced by human or mechanical effort or by a natural process.
Identification of an object, for example the unique number affixed by the manufacturer to a product for identification purposes.
Code specifying the type of commodity identifier.
Details related to the name of a product.

Name or term that identifies the goods assigned by a seller as distinct from those of other sellers, in legal terms known as trademark, which helps to identify one item, a family of items, or all items of that seller.
Code specifying the commodity name (e.g. common name, registered name, brand name).
Details related to the characteristics of a product.
Code specifying the commodity characteristics such as goods grading, genetic modification, quality, etc. that distinguishes the commodity from similar commodities.
Description of the commodity characteristics (e.g. goods grading, genetic modification, quality, etc.) that distinguishes the commodity from similar commodities.
Code specifying the various forms of commodity characteristics.
Details related to the usage of a product.
Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate).
Date and time specifying when a product will be of best flavor or quality.
Date and time best before of the first product in a range.
Date and time best before of the last product in a range.
Details related to the party owning a property.
Name of the owner of the property.
Identification of the owner of the property.
Details related to the source of goods in accordance with regulation and laws.
Name of the source geographic region (non-political).
Code specifying the type of source location.
Details related to the supplier of the goods and or services.
Name of the party who supplies goods and/or services.
Identification of the party who supplies goods and/or services.
Code specifying the storage condition of a commodity.
Details related to the outcome of (governmental) examination.
Quantity specifying the control results of an inspection, carried out by cross border regulatory agencies.
Identification of the place of departure of the goods.
Code specifying the country of departure.
Name of the country of departure.
Identification of a country's subdivision of departure.
Details related to the destination location.
Identification of the location of goods destination.
Code specifying the country of destination.
Name of the country of destination.
Identification of a country's subdivision of destination.

Name of the location where goods are to be examined if different from the specified goods item location.
Identification of a location where goods are to be examined if different from the specified goods item location.
Details related to the export country.
Code specifying the country from which the goods are originally exported without any commercial transaction taken place in intermediate countries.
Name of the country from which the goods are originally exported without any commercial transaction taken place in intermediate countries.
Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.
Code specifying the purpose of the measurement.
Weight of goods including packing but excluding carrier's equipment.
Weight of the goods themselves without any packing.
Quantity specifying the goods in the unit as required by customs for tariff, statistical, fiscal purposes or as indicated in "type".
Amount reported in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd tariff quantity.
Quantity specifying the current annual quota for the species concerned.
Exported to date in current year quantity
Quantity specifying the total number of specimens exported in the current calendar year (1 January to 31 December) (including those covered by the present permit).
Measure of the gross volume of the item, excluding unoccupied volume of the packaging.

Percentage of allowable tolerance (e.g. In order to take into account trade-related issues such as weight differences and moisture increase, an importer could enter up to 5% more than for which a certificate was issued. The number 5 will be recorded. Thus, on a certificate issued for 1000 tons, 1050 tons could be realized.
In derogation from the general rule, preferential import arrangements may contain provisions showing that there is no tolerance. In such cases, the number 0 is entered).
Details related to the information of a commercial invoice.
Identification of an invoice by reference number.
Date and time of issue of an invoice.
Code specifying the type of an invoice.
Details related to the issuing party.
Name of the party having issued the document.
Identification of the party having issued the document.
Details related to the origin of the goods.
Code specifying the criterion of determination as to whether a good qualifies as an originating good in accordance with the rules.

Code specifying the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

Name of the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

Identification of the region in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the purposes of application of the Customs tariff, or quantitative restrictions, or of any other measure related to trade.
Code specifying the differentiation between different types of origin (e.g. preferential and non-preferential country of origin codes).
Marks and or numbers on a transport unit or package.
Quantity specifying the number of individual items packaged in such a way that they cannot be divided without first undoing the packing.
Code specifying the type of package of an item.
Description of the type of material for packaging covered by UN/Recommendation 21.
Weight of a package excluding all outer packing (e.g. 1 carton and its contents alone, without any further outer packaging, such as pallet and wrapping or banding).
Details related to the party packing goods.
Name of the party packing goods.
Identification of the party packing goods.
Details related to transport equipment used for the consignment.
Details related to the seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment, used to secure an object and protect from unauthorized entry or tampering.
Identification of a seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment by number.

Name of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.
Identification of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering the transport.
Quantity specifying the control or quarantine purposes.
Identification of the location where the declaration is reviewed by appropriate government agency. This may be different from place where declaration is lodged, paid, or acquitted.
Name of the location where the declaration is reviewed by appropriate government agency. This may be different from place where declaration is lodged, paid, or acquitted.
Date and time at which a specified event is completed.

Name of the party who has provided the certification.
Identification of a party which certifies something.

Mode of transport at departure code
Code specifying the mode of transport used for the carriage of the goods at departure.

Name of the exhibition in cases where goods are sent from the territory of the exporting Party for exhibition in another country and sold during or after the exhibition for importation into the territory of a Party.
Code specifying the type of an exhibition event.
Details related to the location from where the goods were consigned.
Identification of the location in country or country from which the goods were initially dispatched to the importing country.
Details related to the warehouse where a particular goods shipment will be / is / has been stored.
Date and time when declared goods were/will be carried out of the designated location.

Identification of the location of goods.

Code specifying the country through which goods or passengers are routed between the country of original departure and final destination.
Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.
Name of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
Measure of the flashpoint temperature of dangerous goods.
Temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.
Minimum temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.
Maximum temperature required to be maintained for a commodity, or in a container, or in a conveyance.

Description of delivery or transport terms.

Identification of the party responsible for the trade of commercial products.

Identification of the document evidencing a transport contract by reference number.

ISO, IATA, EDIFACT (8053 or 8155) OR User code list
Identification of the equipment (e.g. unit load device by marks, letters, and/or numbers).
Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignment) are unloaded from the active means of transport having been used for their carriage.

Name of the unloading location, seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which the cargo is to be unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.

Identification of the location of a government office where contact can be made.
Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

Rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.
Details related to the office of entry.
Identification of the regulatory office at which the goods enter the customs territory of destination.
Details related to the office of exit.
Identification of the location of the regulatory office at which the goods leave or are intended to leave the customs territory of dispatch.
Details related to the person/party who makes or on whose behalf an export declaration is made.

Name of the person who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar right of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

Identification of the party who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar rights of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.
Details related to the party who makes - or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes - an import declaration.

Name of the party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who is in possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.

Identification of a party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who has possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.
Details related to the party to whom the license, permit, certificate, or other required document (LPCO) is issued.
Name of the party to whom the license, permit, certificate, or other required document (LPCO) is issued.
Identification of the party to whom the license, permit, certificate, or other required document (LPCO) is issued.
Details related to the undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure).
Date and time when the document/message was cancelled.
Code specifying the status of a document.
Amount indicating the total value of the guarantee.
Code specifying the type of activity being guaranteed.
Identification of the undertaking given as a written guarantee in cash, bond, or by other such means in order to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled by reference number.
Code specifying details regarding undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure).
Details related to a national reference.
Code specifying the name of the national reference issuing country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.

Name of the party (i.e., Principal, Co-principal, or User) who is responsible for fulfilling the obligations covered by the Customs bond or who benefits from being able to obligate a Customs bond.

Identification of the party (i.e., Principal, Co-principal, or User) who is responsible for fulfilling the obligations covered by the Customs bond or who benefits from being able to obligate a Customs bond.

Date and time the bond user is removed from the bond.

Identification of a party to be notified.

Identification of the party who agrees to be responsible for the debt or obligation of another.
Amount indicating the Surety's liability on the Customs bond.

Identification of a party authorized to act on behalf of another party.

Code specifying the type of seal applied on a unit of transport equipment.
Code specifying the type of governmental examination.
Digital information resulting from an inspection or examination (e.g. x-ray scan of a container).

Details related to the customs offices of transit.
Identification of the government office which is responsible for transit formalities enroute.

Code specifying the type of Transit operation termination.
Details related to the government agency office where the transit operation terminates.
Details related to the discharge of an operation.
Details related to the government agency office related to the transit operation.
Identification of the location of the government agency office related to the transit operation.
Details related to the refusal to start an operation.
Details related to the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and - when applicable - a guarantee.

Principal Class (68C) with Role Code "AF" (Transit principal) can be used instead.
Name of the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and, when applicable, a guarantee.
Identification of the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and - when applicable - a guarantee.
Details related to the withdrawal of an authorization.
Date and time the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate) is effective.
Code specifying the country of exclusion.
Details related to the previous document.
Identification of the previous document by number.
Code specifying the type of document used for declaration previously presented.
Details related to the person acting as a representative.
Name of the representative of the party making the declaration.
Identification of the government agency, responsible for regulatory and statutory obligations.
Name of the location or port of departure, shipment or destination, as required under the applicable terms of delivery (i.e., Incoterms).
Code specifying the country code to cover the cases when UNLOCODE is not available to define a delivery terms location in IM/EX declarations.
Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

Only to be used for LPCO/ObligationGuarantee.
